recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. A future purely editorial cleanup could remove the outer quote marks if desired, but no source change is needed to reconcile FHIR-34385.
issue_request: FHIR-34385 is a Published FHIR-core change request with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked FHIR-I to clarify or remove the parenthetical phrase "extensional definition" in the slicing discriminator guidance and resolved to use "(formally called an 'Extensional' value set)".
initial_application: Git commit 2d85e098faf71496c18c41a5bed185f764fb59a9, "Fix FHIR-34385", changed source/profiling.html from the old "extensional definition" parenthetical to the current "formally called an 'Extensional' value set" wording. The current source still carries that applied text at source/profiling.html:691.
additional_context: A Zulip FHIR-I block-vote message from the reporter pulled an earlier proposed wording because "formally called an extensional definition" still did not explain what the parenthetical meant. The final Jira resolution and applied source instead use "Extensional value set". Exact Jira phrase search found only FHIR-34385, broader Jira search only surfaced background discriminator issues, and Confluence searches found no conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source already resolves the substantive request by replacing the unclear phrase with wording that names an Extensional value set; the remaining outer quote marks around the parenthetical are editorial punctuation and do not justify a source-changing reconciliation commit.
